original_test_intent: Switch the approved Mellanox port to Ethernet mode and measure supported two-host network bandwidth after DC activation, reaching a project-defined 90%-of-ideal floor without losing configuration or manageability.
original_method: Resolve whether the source intends RoCE ib_write_bw or native Ethernet iperf; map adapter/P1/netdev/RDMA/GID/peer; snapshot and set LINK_TYPE_P1=2; controlled DC cycle; verify active Ethernet link/speed/FEC/MTU/VLAN/PFC/ECN and assign collision-free IP; only then run the approved finite transport with complete parameters/repeats/counters; compute unit-correct 90% floor; restore mode/network and cycle if required.
manual_activity: Network owner selects supported Ethernet/RoCE transport and approves persistent mode/power changes; operator controls DC/OOB recovery.
required_inputs: RoCE versus iperf decision and versions
safety_requirements: Do not run ib_write_bw until RoCE path is proven
Restore prior state; no auto-retry or log clearing

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only the LINK_TYPE setting aligns; it omits the rest and cannot establish ib_write_bw validity in Ethernet mode.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After transport approval, use either a validated RoCE perftest path with exact GID/traffic-class/PFC settings or an approved native Ethernet tool; do not assume the source placeholder works.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: P1=2, DC cycle, /24, port 3000 and 90% objective retained; tool semantics pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Separate persistent Ethernet-mode activation from transport validation, then execute a protocol-specific finite benchmark tied to negotiated link rate.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves missing RoCE/native-Ethernet semantics and adds full fabric, safety, measurement and restoration controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Mode activation alone does not measure bandwidth; an unsupported verbs command cannot be treated as Ethernet coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: RoCE needs correct GID/routing/PFC/ECN while iperf measures a different stack; either can produce a misleading 90% comparison if ideal and protocol are undefined.

project_override_considerations: Owner decides protocol/tool, L2/L3/RoCE version, GID index, lossless settings, link rate, message/stream/direction/repeats/statistic and payload ideal.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master calls this Ethernet mode but specifies an unresolved verbs command, while DeepSeek only covers the mode setting; no source establishes the required RoCE/native transport contract.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete and classified per approved four-state rules as package/user-confirmation; execution is held until transport semantics and mutable target are approved.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row440 Wistron-Networking-00051-V002: decide RoCE ib_write_bw versus native Ethernet tool, approve adapter/P1/netdev/RDMA/GID/peer and prior LINK_TYPE, DC/OOB rollback, MTU/FEC/VLAN/PFC/ECN/IP, finite traffic profile, negotiated-link ideal/units and 90% statistic/tolerance.

review_improvement: Prevents an Ethernet label from silently authorizing an unproven verbs benchmark and makes protocol-specific coverage explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: LINK_TYPE_P1=2 only selects Ethernet link behavior; it does not prove that an RDMA CM/GID route or lossless RoCE fabric exists. Tool selection determines what layer is measured, so the 90% oracle is meaningless until transport and payload ideal are fixed.
